claims: 2026 is a common year starting on Thursday of the Gregorian calendar.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup will be hosted by the US, Canada, and Mexico (June–July).
The 2026 FIFA World Cup will feature 48 teams.
Italy will host the Winter Olympics and Paralympics.
NASA's Artemis II is planned for April 2026.
NASA's Artemis II marks the first crewed deep-space mission since 1972.
A total solar eclipse will occur on August 12, 2026.
The total solar eclipse on August 12, 2026 will be visible over Greenland, Iceland, and Spain.
July 4, 2026 marks the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence.
2026 is the year of the Fire Horse in the Chinese zodiac.
US New Year's Day public holiday is January 1.
US Independence Day public holiday is observed July 3.
US Thanksgiving public holiday is November 26.
US Christmas public holiday is December 25.
